# yspecx

yspecx extends [yspec](https://github.com/metrumresearchgroup/yspec) for
validating data sets against their specifications.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("OmarAshkar/yspecx")
```

## What it does

- **Check** a data set:
  [`ysx_check()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check.md),
  [`ysx_check_missing()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check_missing.md)
  and
  [`ysx_check_repeats()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check_repeats.md).
- **Set groups** in a specification:
  [`ysx_regroup()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_regroup.md)
  and
  [`ysx_ungroup()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_ungroup.md).
- **Build and edit** specifications:
  [`df_to_yspec()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/df_to_yspec.md),
  [`ys_sort_spec_vars()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ys_sort_spec_vars.md),
  [`ys_write()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ys_write.md)
  and
  [`ysx_load_pkpdspec()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_load_pkpdspec.md).
- **Use** a specification:
  [`ysx_factors()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_factors.md)
  and
  [`ysx_plt_relab()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_plt_relab.md).

See the [articles](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/articles/) for
worked examples.

# Package index

## Checks

Check a data set against its specification.

- [`ysx_check()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check.md)
  : Check a data set against its specification with extra checks
- [`ysx_check_missing()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check_missing.md)
  : Check missing values against a specification
- [`ysx_check_repeats()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_check_repeats.md)
  : Check the number of rows in each group

## Groups

Set or remove the columns that define groups.

- [`ysx_regroup()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_regroup.md)
  : Replace the group columns of a specification
- [`ysx_ungroup()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_ungroup.md)
  : Remove the group columns of a specification

## Build and edit specifications

- [`df_to_yspec()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/df_to_yspec.md)
  : Convert a data frame to a yspec yaml file
- [`ys_sort_spec_vars()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ys_sort_spec_vars.md)
  : Sort specification variables to match a data frame
- [`ys_write()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ys_write.md)
  : Write a yspec object to a YAML file
- [`ysx_load_pkpdspec()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_load_pkpdspec.md)
  : Load the bundled PK/PD (NONMEM) specification

## Use specifications

- [`ysx_factors()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_factors.md)
  : Convert columns to factors with specification-controlled ordering
- [`ysx_plt_relab()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/yspecx/reference/ysx_plt_relab.md)
  : Relabel plot titles, legends and facet strips from a specification
